customManagers.description: Task-set tool pins must equal baseline.toml (tests/test_task_sets.py), so they move in the baseline pull request

packageRules.description: One pull request per baseline bump
This repository's own mise.toml follows the baseline through `toolchains.py sync`
kubectl stays within one minor of the staging GKE server (1.35); move the bound with the cluster
nextest tags releases as cargo-nextest-<version>, matching the baseline's version_prefix
gh-actions-updater owns every uses: ref, pinned to its bare major tag (org ADR-0008)
